result.title: scratch: replay the names probe workflows
result.body:
Scratch probe PR. Never merged; closed unmerged as the permanent record.

Re-measures the workflow set that `tests/integration/names.test.ts` (deleted in dbc607c) was captured against — `names.yml`, `names-caller.yml`, `names-mid.yml`, `names-reusable.yml`, `matrix-expr.yml` — copied byte-for-byte from `tests/fixtures/willrun-probe/.github/workflows/`. Unchanged is the point: a modified workflow measures something else.

`src/matrix-expr.txt` exists only to satisfy `matrix-expr.yml`'s `paths:` filter.

commit.message:
Decide vars.* guards from the repo's variable listing (#351)

* Decide vars.* guards from the repo's variable listing

vars was grouped with secrets as undecidable, but repo-level variables
are one authenticated GET away at prediction time, which GOALS.md goal 5
permits. The client gains listRepoVariables (the variables route caps
per_page at 30, unlike every other list route), willfire memoizes one
read per prediction, and expansion awaits it only for a workflow whose
jobs mention the vars context - so a prediction that never meets one
still makes no extra API call, and recorded replays without the route
stay valid.

Lookup matches variable names case-insensitively, as GitHub does. An
unlisted name stays unknown: org- and environment-level variables are
invisible to the repo listing, so absence decides nothing. A 403 or 404
on the listing is settled - the token cannot see the variables - and
degrades every vars lookup to unknown, exactly the pre-change verdict;
any other failure aborts the prediction rather than degrading a
decidable guard only on bad days.

Fixes #323

release: minor

* e2e attestation for feat/vars-from-repo-variables

Full suite, no exclusions: the prior receipts' exclusion terms were
already dropped on main and every case passes here (5/5, exit 0).

release: minor

* Kill the gate's surviving mutants around the vars read

A declared function replaces the arrow const the mutation runner cannot
attribute coverage to; the new assertions pin that a listed variable
never serves another context's key and that a word merely starting with
vars does not trigger the read.

release: minor

* Refresh the e2e receipt for the post-mutation-fix source

Full suite, no exclusions, re-run after rebasing onto main at the commit
the mutants died in (5/5, exit 0).

release: minor

commit.message:
Drop matrix-expr from the probe head

Its `paths: src/matrix-expr.txt` trigger also fires conventions-src.yml, whose
runtime-computed matrix makes the capture download the repo tarball — now 289
MB, because every committed fixture tarball is inside it. The matrix-expr
dispatch is already recorded on run 36430176360 at the first head.

release: skip

name: putitoutthere check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'putitoutthere.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'scripts/*/package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/release.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/check.yml'

jobs:
  putitoutthere-check:
    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/check.yml@v0

name: Testing Conventions (willfire)

# Runs the upstream testing-conventions gates over the root `willfire` package,
# pinned to the rolling `v0` tag (the same convention as check.yml).
#
# Every gate runs (`gates` left at its empty default): mutation's Stryker deps
# are in devDependencies, and `e2e-attestations/` holds the receipt the
# e2e-verify gate checks.
#
# One workflow file per workspace package (docs/monorepo.md), because `paths:`
# is per-file and each package's lane has a different trigger set.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-src.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-src.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Job id kept as-is: it prefixes every check name this call produces.
  conventions:
    uses: thekevinscott/testing-conventions/.github/workflows/testing-conventions.yml@v0
    with:
      languages: '["typescript"]'
      source: src

name: integration

# The suite builds `src` and replays `tests/integration`, importing
# `tests/cases.ts` and `tests/getResponse.ts`; `attestations.test.ts` reads
# `e2e-attestations/`. `tests/e2e` and `tests/fixtures` are read by no CI job.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - 'tests/cases.ts'
      - 'tests/getResponse.ts'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integration:
    name: integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test:integration

name: lint

name: Release

# putitoutthere's reusable workflow; config lives in `putitoutthere.toml`
# at the repo root.
#
# Auth: the `NPM_TOKEN` secret is the first-publish bootstrap only —
# Trusted Publishing on npm binds to an already-published package, so
# the very first publish has no OIDC path. `willfire` is published:
# register the trusted publisher (repo thekevinscott/willfire,
# workflow release.yml, environment release), then DELETE the NPM_TOKEN
# secret; the OIDC exchange takes over.
#
# Filename matters: npm's trust policy matches the caller workflow
# filename. Renaming this file requires re-registering the trusted
# publisher.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_packages:
        description: >
          Packages to release manually, bypassing change detection.
          Comma-separated list of name[@<bump|version>] entries, e.g.
          "willfire@minor" or "willfire@1.2.0". Leave empty to fall back
          to automatic change detection (same as a push).
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  release:
    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/release.yml@v0
    with:
      release_packages: ${{ inputs.release_packages || '' }}
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      # Required even for the token-auth bootstrap publish: the
      # reusable workflow's publish job declares id-token: write, and
      # a caller granting less is a startup error.
      id-token: write

  # PyPI upload runs in the caller's workflow context (see
  # pypi/warehouse#11096). The `if:` gate skips this job for non-PyPI
  # repos — pasted verbatim per putitoutthere's README regardless of
  # what the repo publishes.
  pypi-publish:
    needs: release
    if: needs.release.outputs.has_pypi == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: '*-sdist'
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: '*-wheel-*'
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
